title: LR warmup at DEPTH=9
description: Changed WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05 at DEPTH=9 baseline, all else unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 1.003182, worse than the 0.998924 baseline. Warmup hurts at this width/depth rather than helping - the immediate-full-LR start was not actually destabilizing training, contrary to the hypothesis behind three independent proposals this round. This closes the warmup axis as a negative result; don't retry warmup at other fractions without a new reason to believe it'd behave differently. The schedule-shape space (warmup, warmdown, weight_decay) now looks fully explored and dead at model_dim=640 - future rounds should look at a genuinely new axis (e.g. decoupling depth/width via ASPECT_RATIO or HEAD_DIM, or architecture-level changes) rather than more LR schedule tweaks.
